crossRefs.note: Then Moses set apart three cities beyond the Jordan toward the sunrise,
If Yahweh your God enlarges your border, as he has sworn to your fathers, and gives you all the land which he promised…
They set apart Kedesh in Galilee in the hill country of Naphtali, Shechem in the hill country of Ephraim, and Kiriath…

people.name: Canaan
people.line: Ancient region; descendants of Ham; promised to Abraham's descendants

people.name: Jordan
people.line: A river and region, significant in Israel's history

translations.web: You shall give three cities beyond the Jordan, and you shall give three cities in the land of Canaan. They shall be cities of refuge.
translations.bsb: Select three cities across the Jordan and three in the land of Canaan as cities of refuge.
translations.kjv: Ye shall give three cities on this side Jordan, and three cities shall ye give in the land of Canaan, which shall be cities of refuge.
translations.asv: Ye shall give three cities beyond the Jordan, and three cities shall ye give in the land of Canaan; they shall be cities of refuge.
